mapper.insert: INSERT INTO burndown_snapshots (sprint_id, snapshot_date, remaining_points, completed_points, total_points, snapshot_type) VALUES (#{sprintId}, #{snapshotDate}, #{remainingPoints}, #{completedPoints}, #{totalPoints}, #{snapshotType}) ON CONFLICT (sprint_id, snapshot_date) DO UPDATE SET remaining_points = EXCLUDED.remaining_points, completed_points = EXCLUDED.completed_points, total_points = EXCLUDED.total_points, snapshot_type = EXCLUDED.snapshot_type
mapper.select: SELECT bs.* FROM burndown_snapshots bs JOIN sprints s ON s.id = bs.sprint_id WHERE s.project_id = #{projectId} AND bs.snapshot_type = 'COMPLETE' ORDER BY s.sort_order ASC, bs.snapshot_date ASC
